verses: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ
وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
حِكْمَةٌۢ بَٰلِغَةٌ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ
خُشَّعًا أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ
مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ
فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ
وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ
وَحَمَلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ
تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَٰهَآ ءَايَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ
تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ
فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ
سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ
فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ نَّجَّيْنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ
نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ
سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ
فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ

Shared motifs, rarest first: Everything they did is in the scriptures (zubur); every small and great thing is written down (weight 6.7). Pair score 6.7.

Only in Epilogue on Qohelet, many books, and the whole duty of man: Editorial epilogue speaks of Qohelet in the third person: a sage who taught the people, weighed and arranged many proverbs; The end of the matter: fear God and keep his commandments, for this is the whole of man; God will bring every deed into judgment, every hidden thing, whether good or evil; Of making many books there is no end, and much study wearies the flesh; The words of the wise are like goads and like nails firmly fixed, given by one shepherd; Whoever does an atom's weight (mithqal dharra) of good will see it, and an atom's weight of evil will see it; God will judge the righteous and the wicked, for there is a time for every matter.

Only in Refrains over 'Ad, Thamud's she-camel, Lot's guests and Pharaoh; everything by measure; the seat of truth: God's command is but one, like a blink of the eye; The guilty are dragged on their faces into the Fire: 'Taste the touch of Saqar'; The God-fearing are in gardens and a river, in a seat of truth with an all-powerful King; A single Cry (sayha) is sent and they become like the dry stubble of a pen-builder; When they solicited Lot's guests, God obliterated their eyes; 'The host will be routed and turn their backs' (applied to Badr); God created everything by measure/decree (bi-qadar); 'Are your unbelievers better than those, or have you an immunity (bara'a) in the scriptures (zubur)?'; Lot's family is saved at the time before dawn (bi-sahar) while a storm of stones (hasib) destroys the rest; Supernatural being must leave before daybreak; Refrain: 'How then were my punishment and my warnings?' matches.label: Who strikes the Sodom mob's eyes
matches.note: The mob blinded at Lot's door. Genesis: ʾayyēh hā-ʾănāšîm ... hôṣîʾēm ʾēlênû wə-nēḏəʿāh ʾōṯām; the angels (hā-ʾănāšîm) strike them bas-sanwērîm and they weary themselves finding the door. Quran: wa-la-qad rāwadūhu ʿan ḍayfihi fa-ṭamasnā aʿyunahum fa-dhūqū ʿadhābī wa-nudhur (God says 'We blotted out their eyes'). The striking passes from the angel-guests to God himself, and the search for the door is dropped.

matches.label: Hero's family saved with him
matches.note: Why Lot is saved. Genesis: wa-yyizkōr ʾĕlōhîm ʾeṯ ʾaḇrāhām wa-yšallaḥ ʾeṯ lôṭ mit-tôḵ ha-hăp̄ēḵâ (for Abraham's sake), and earlier bə-ḥemlaṯ YHWH ʿālâw (19:16, God's pity in spite of his delay). evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/07-hb-quran.yaml).

Shared motifs, rarest first: How the ark is described [divergence between the texts] (weight 6.7); What sets the flood in motion: God's decision on violence, or the rejected prophet's prayer [divergence between the texts] (weight 6.7); Waters pour both from the sky and from springs of the earth (weight 6.0). Only in The Flood (full read): Clean animals taken aboard by sevens, unclean by pairs; Flood events given exact calendar dates (year of hero's life, month, day); Rain or flood lasts forty days and forty nights; God regrets having made humankind and is grieved in his heart; God himself shuts the vessel's door behind the hero; A dove returns with an olive leaf in its beak; A raven is sent out and does not return (goes to and fro); Seven days pass between the warning or boarding and the onset of the flood; Vessel has several decks, a side door and a roof opening or window; God sends a wind (ruah) over the earth to make the waters subside; Angels object that the new human will corrupt the earth and shed blood while they praise God; When the water overflowed God carried 'you' in the running ship (al-jariya) as a reminder for retaining ears [divergence between the texts]; and 43 more.

(fa-hal min muddakir); The sign left after the flood: the rainbow, or the ark [divergence between the texts]; Bring the whole tithe to the storehouse and test God: he will open the windows of heaven and pour out blessing without limit; and 4 more.

matches.note: Who sets the flood in motion. Genesis: wa-yyōʾmer ʾĕlōhîm lə-nōaḥ qēṣ kol bāśār bāʾ ləp̄ānay kî mālʾâ hā-ʾāreṣ ḥāmās (God decides, because of violence, and tells Noah).
